title: MIN and MAX of a text column compare alphabetically
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "min", MIN ( Product[Product] ), "max", MAX ( Product[Product] ) )

source.quote: Strings are compared according to alphabetical order.
Strings are compared according to alphabetical order.

derivation: Product[Product] holds Bike, Helmet, Lock, Scooter. Alphabetically first is Bike, last is Scooter.
